# sym

> Read the function, not the file. Symbol-level code reads for AI coding agents: a file's skeleton, one symbol's source with its docs, or a budgeted map of a directory, parsed with tree-sitter. Keeps whole files out of context so prompt caching stays intact. Languages: Rust, Lua, Python, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript, Go, C, C++, Java, Ruby.

Operated by Stardata (Cody Lee Walker, Canada). Contact: cody@stardata.foundation.

## Local (free)

- Install: `cargo install sym-cli` (binary `sym`).
- CLI: `sym ls <file>`, `sym read <file> <symbol>`, `sym map <dir> --budget N`; `--json`, `--est`.
- MCP over stdio: `{"command":"sym","args":["mcp"]}` → tools `sym_ls`, `sym_read`, `sym_map`.
- Claude Code plugin: `claude plugin marketplace add https://github.com/codylwalker/sym` then `claude plugin install sym@sym`.

## Hosted (paid per call)

- MCP over HTTP: `claude mcp add --transport http sym-hosted https://api.s2ar.dev/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"`. Tools `sym_map_repo`, `sym_ls_repo`, `sym_read_repo`, `buy_credits` (returns the payment link; pay it with the Link agent wallet, then send the key as the Bearer header).

- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/sym/map` body `{"repo": "<public git url>", "ref": "<tag|branch>", "budget": 1000}` → `{ok, text, data, tokens_est, charged_usd}`. $0.01 per call.
- `POST https://api.s2ar.dev/v1/sym/read` body `{"repo", "ref", "file", "symbol"}`. $0.005 per call.
- Unpaid requests get HTTP 402 carrying every rail: `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` (Stripe Machine Payments Protocol: cards via Shared Payment Tokens, USDC via Tempo), an x402 body (USDC on Base, header `X-PAYMENT`), and a `checkout_url` for a human to buy a credit pack (then `Authorization: Bearer <key>`).
- Agent skill for card payments: `npx skills add stripe/link-cli`. Test mode is supported.
- Failed requests are never charged. Only public repositories are read; checkouts are cached for one hour and never logged.

## Example prompts

- "Use sym_map on this repo with a 1200-token budget, then sym_read the function that parses the --glob flag."
- "Before reading src/searcher.rs, run sym ls on it and pick the symbol."
- "Map https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep at 14.1.1 through api.s2ar.dev and tell me which file has the most importers."
